id: \bEmerald: My name is Emerald. With my E Shooter I can calm a Pokémon by surrounding it with a "seal" of soil from its birthplace.
en: \bEmerald: My name is Emerald. With my E Shooter I can calm a Pokémon by surrounding it with a "seal" of soil from its birthplace.
it: \bEmerald: Mi chiamo Emerald. Con il mio Lancia-E posso calmare un Pokémon circondandolo con un "sigillo" di terra del suo luogo di nascita.

id: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Calmer.
en: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Calmer.
it: \bPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Calmatore.

id: \bEmerald: I never said I would win. It doesn't matter anyways. It's just a battle.
en: \bEmerald: I never said I would win. It doesn't matter anyways. It's just a battle.
it: \bEmerald: Non ho mai detto che avrei vinto. Tanto non importa. È solo una lotta.
